summary: The Definitive Collection is a 1997 greatest hits compilation gathering all of Cleveland, Ohio singer-songwriter Eric Carmen's singles. It includes five Raspberries hits from the power pop group Carmen led in the early 1970s, along with his versions of two major songs he wrote for Shaun Cassidy and two popular songs from the film Dirty Dancing. It also features his biggest hit, "All By Myself".
one_line: A 1997 greatest hits compilation of Eric Carmen's singles, including Raspberries hits, songs written for Shaun Cassidy, and "All By Myself".
key_facts: The Definitive Collection is a 1997 greatest hits compilation album.

Eric Carmen is described as a singer-songwriter from Cleveland, Ohio.
The album features five hits by the Raspberries.
The Raspberries are described as a power pop group which Eric Carmen led in the early 1970s.
The album contains Eric Carmen's versions of two major hits he wrote for Shaun Cassidy.
The album includes two popular songs from the movie "Dirty Dancing".
The album includes "All By Myself", which is described as Eric Carmen's greatest hit.
